oracle.scope: Shared full target/plan/diff/impact/diagnostic projection; dry-run never enters any publication backend or writes a receipt. Exact supplied readback is verified after trusted publication, without claiming independent durability proof. Exact raw plan bytes are retained; source state is read again after locked revalidation. Explicit prepared operations yield a write-free full preview; saved plans execute through real locks, authorization, journals, receipts and cleanup. Native target and plan equality, historical audit and replay are measured in owned fixtures; CLI/raw-intent preview allocation and complete command error/continuation audit are not claimed. 7.k.R: native saved-plan failure reports preserve actual write/recovery state, distinguish planned identities and roots from publication, and reject conflicting or damaged retry proofs. A real create/update/link/review/retire chain uses freshly loaded models and verified historical replays without new IDs or revisions. The final retirement uses explicit fixture host gates bound to the unchanged review and independently expected complete target; it does not prove authentic history acquisition or generic approval authority. 7.k.C relocates the unchanged W/R domain scenarios, execution helpers and behavior oracles into shared test support. Test bodies, parameterizations, helper logic, fixture authority boundaries and all test identities remain unchanged; product source bytes are unchanged.
